name: GIST - Gist Intune Script Trigger
description: GIST - Gist Intune Script Trigger is a compact collection of PowerShell scripts for diagnosing and troubleshooting Intune devices. It features a menu-driven interface accessible via a simple one-liner (iwr gist.ittips.ch | iex) and supports direct gist IDs for quick runs. The scripts require no parameters, have no external dependencies, and prioritize safety by not altering system settings.
author: Marius

securityCheck.aiSummary: High risk due to remote script execution from untrusted URLs via Invoke-Expression. The code itself does not harvest credentials or exfiltrate data, but it enables dynamic execution of external scripts, which can undermine security controls in an Intune environment. Recommend replacing dynamic remote script execution with signed, verified local scripts, eliminating Invoke-Expression, and adding strict allowlisting, integrity checks (hash verification), and comprehensive logging.
